description.value:
Meteoric iron folded around the melted chain-links of a decommissioned soul-engine, etched with one unbroken warding sigil that never quite finished its circuit. It wants to close the loop. You're the excuse it gets to.

SIGNATURE — against a Named target, Break the Anchor lets a hit cut straight past its rage entirely, dealing bonus precision damage that ignores resistance to non-magical harm — you're not fighting the haunting, you're striking the wound underneath it.
